subject: fileInput using shiny server and IE10

messages.author: 272e36d328a471bb
messages.subject: fileInput using shiny server and IE10
parts:
Hi,
First of all many thanks for entire shiny team, shiny is awesome.
I have used shiny locally to develop simple app which uploads a .csv file and displays histogram for each column.
I am using shiny version 0.9.1 , IE 10 and also Chrome. It works fine in this environment,

When I moved to shiny server version v 1.2.1.362 the app is running fine in Chrome, but using IE 10 file is not getting uploaded.

Can any one confirm if uploading file using IE10 works for shiny server ?

Many thanks.

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: fileInput using shiny server and IE10
parts:
Shashank,

I created an environment similar to yours: Shiny 0.9.1, Shiny Server v 1.2.1.362. Using IE10, I can successfully upload a csv file using "09_upload" example application. Can you try using this application instead of your application to see if that works?

Thanks,
Fereshteh
